multi_entity_note: Affiliate agreement between Link Plus Corporation (LKPL) and Axiometric, LLC.
processing_note: Payments due shall be made within 45 days of the                            close of each calendar quarter.

contract.document_name.rationale: The contract is titled AFFILIATE AGREEMENT; the first heading adds a misspelling and the date.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The heading dates the agreement July 15, 2005 and it is entered into as of the Effective Date, defined as July 15, 2005; May 3, 2005 is the letter of intent and 8/2/2005 the filing date.

contract.effective_date.rationale: Exhibit A defines the Effective Date as July 15, 2005.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The agreement remains in force in perpetuity; no expiration date is stated.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 7.4 applies the laws of the State of Maryland; other Maryland occurrences are venue, addresses or organisation state.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: The agreement is perpetual with no renewal term.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No non-renewal notice period is stated; the listed periods concern office space, payments or limitation of actions.
